flows.title: Create an app from the My Apps page
steps: Once signed in to AppSheet, the My Apps page is displayed by default. To get back to it later, click My Apps in the top navigation.
Click + Create, then choose how to start: with your own data, from a sample app template, with a blank app, or by using Gemini.
The app opens. Try out the live app in the welcome modal, then click Customize with AppSheet to go to the AppSheet app editor.

flows.title: Create an AppSheet database by importing a Google Sheet
steps: In AppSheet, select Create > Database > Import from Sheets.
Navigate to and select the Sheet to import. A new AppSheet database is created from the Sheet's data and opened in the database editor, named after the Sheet.
If pop-ups are blocked in your browser, the database may not open by itself. Click Databases in the top navigation, then click the new database to open it.
Each of the Sheet's tables appears as a tab in the database editor. Select a table's tab to view and manage its columns and rows.

flows.title: Add a view to an app
steps: Open the app in the AppSheet app editor, then select Apps > Views in the navigation bar. The Views page is displayed.
In the navigation pane, click + next to Primary Navigation. The Add a new view dialog is displayed.
Edit the new view: change the View name field, choose the table in the For this data drop-down, and choose a View type such as deck.
In the top toolbar, click Save to save the changes to your app.
